expected_findings.description: The `n_lines` calculation is character-indexed rather than line-indexed, so it can over-count by one when the dropped text ends with a newline.
The `Address this...` instruction runs inline directly onto the last field line because `_WRAPPER` has no trailing newline between `{detail}` and the instruction text.
With `limit=0` or `limit=1`, `half = 0` and `text[-0:]` evaluates to the entire string, causing incorrect truncation behavior; this is unreachable with the default `limit=4000` but has no guard.
